dct_title_s: King County, Washington : water supply wells, group B (2 to 14 connections)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Public Water System wells (group B) with 2 to 14 connections, as recorded by the Washington Department of Health. See also the related datasets: water supply wells, group A, and water supply wells, all datalayers.
Purpose: A general purpose datalayer suitable for mapping or analyses involving groundwater source locations.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
Data credit: Washington Department of Health
